examples.description: Production-grade, end-to-end pandas testing suite demonstrating assert_frame_equal, mock I/O, schemas, and edge case parameters.

assets.description: Machine-readable knowledge base for pandas testing frameworks, assertions, and validation schemas.

edge_cases: Time Series lag and timezone invariants

best_practices: Never use plain assert elements with == or .equals() on DataFrames
Always separate data transformations from raw disk read/write files in tests
Define small, minimal inline fixtures instead of loading production samples
Mock external I/O operations using unittest.mock patch
